name: NOVA Home
description: A premium soft-glass tiled home screen with a large centered Play button and polished motion.

accent.name: Accent colour
accent.description: The colour used for tile borders, icon highlights, and the play tile.

entrance-animation.name: Smooth entrance animations
entrance-animation.description: Slide and gently scale tiles into place when entering the home screen.

secondary-tiles.name: Show secondary tiles
secondary-tiles.description: Turn Settings, Stats and Achievements into small utility tiles when these buttons exist.

reposition-title.name: Compact header logo
reposition-title.description: Move the Geometry Dash logo higher and scale it down slightly for room.

glass-panel.name: Show soft glass backdrop
glass-panel.description: Show a subtle transparent background behind the tile layout.
